40013471.author: पदार्थः
40013471.content: महात्मनः of the great, तस्य वानरस्य of  vanara's, तत् वचनम् the speech, श्रुत्वा on hearing, रावणः Ravana, क्रोधमूर्छितः overwhelmed with anger, तस्य his, वधम् slaying, आज्ञापयत् ordered.

40013471.author: Translation
40013471.content: Hearing the great vanara's speech, Ravana overwhelmed with anger ordered the execution of Hanuman.

40013472.author: पदार्थः
40013472.content: दुरात्मना by the wicked self, रावणेन by Ravana, तस्य his, वधे killing, समाज्ञप्ते when ordered, विभीषणः Vibhishana, दौत्यम् message, निवेदितवतः who had  declared (the purpose of his visit), नानुमेने did not approve.

40013472.author: Translation
40013472.content: Vibhishana did not approve of the killing of Hanuman, who had declared that he was an envoy (of Sri Rama) when the wicked Ravana ordered his murder.

40013473.author: पदार्थः
40013473.content: कार्यविधौ the right course of action, स्थितः stood, तम् him, रक्षोधिपतिम् lord of demons, क्रुद्धम् angry, उपस्थितम् approached near, तत् that, कार्यं च mission also, विदित्वा having known, कार्यम् action, चिन्तयामास  pondered.

40013473.author: Translation
40013473.content: Vibhishana who stood by the right course of action, having realised that the lord of demons was angry pondered over his duty.

40013474.author: पदार्थः
40013474.content: ततः then, निश्चितार्थः decided about action, शत्रुजित् winner of enemies, वाक्यविशारदः skilled in speech, पूज्यम् reverential, अग्रजम् to his elder brother, अत्यर्थम् profound, हितम् wholesome, वाक्यम् words, साम्ना by soothing words, उवाच addressed.

40013474.author: Translation
40013474.content: Then Vibhishana, who was skilled in speech having decided about his duty   addressed his reverential elder brother, a conqueror of enemies in soothing, words in a meaningful, wholesome manner.

40013475.author: पदार्थः
40013475.content: राक्षसेन्द्र O king of ogres, क्षमस्व forgive, रोषम् wrath,त्यज  give up, प्रसीद be pleased, इदम् these, मद्वाक्यम् my words, शृणुष्व hear, परावरज्ञाः knower of what is exalted and what is mean (basic values of life), सन्तः good men, वसुधाधिपेन्द्राः kings of the earth, दूतस्य an envoy, वधम् killing, न कुर्वन्ति do not do.

40013475.author: Translation
40013475.content: "O king of ogres give up your wrath, forgive and calm down. Please listen to my appeal. You know the basic values of life. Virtuous rulers of the earth do not order killing of an envoy.

40013476.author: पदार्थः
40013476.content: वीर warrior, अस्य his, कपेः monkey's, प्रमापणम् killing, राजधर्मविरुद्धं च contrary to righteousness of kings, लोकवृत्तेश्च to fair diplomacy, गर्हितम् depreciable, तव च and your, असदृशम् unbecoming act.

40013476.author: Translation
40013476.content: "Mighty king killing this Hanuman is contrary to righteousness of kings. This is deplorable diplomacy and also unbecoming of you.

40013477.author: पदार्थः
40013477.content: त्वमेव you alone, धर्मज्ञश्च knower of dharma, कृतज्ञश्च you have a sense of gratitude, राजधर्मविशारदः knower of king's dharma, भूतानाम् among beings, परावरज्ञः knower of right and wrong practices, परमार्थवित् knower of supreme truth.

40013477.author: Translation
40013477.content: "You are conversant with  dharma of a king.  You have a sense of gratitude. You are a knower of right and wrong of all beings. the supeme truth.

40013478.author: पदार्थः
40013478.content: त्वादृशः persons like you, विचक्षण: a wise one, रोषेण with unjust anger, गृह्यन्ते overpowered, ततः then, शास्त्रविपश्चित्त्वम् learning scriptures, केवलम् a mere, श्रम एव हि only fruitless labour.

40013478.author: Translation
40013478.content: "If wise persons like you are also overpowered by unjust anger, then the mastery of  the scriptures will become a mere fruitless exercise.

40013479.author: पदार्थः
40013479.content: शत्रघ्न O destoyer of foes, दुरासद O unassailable, राक्षसेन्द्र king of demon, तस्मात् therefore, प्रसीद calm down, युक्तायुक्तम् that which is proper and improper, विनिश्चित्य  after careful deliberation, दूतदण्डः punishment for the emissary, विधीयताम् may be impose.

40013479.author: Translation
40013479.content: "O destroyer of foes, O unassailable king of demon calm down. Only after carefully considering what is proper and improper decide on the punishment to be imposed".

40013480.author: पदार्थः
40013480.content: राक्षसेश्वरः lord of ogres, रावणः Ravana, विभीषणवचः Vibhishana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, महता higly, रोषेण with anger, आविष्टः overcome, उत्तरम् reply, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoken.

40013480.author: Translation
40013480.content: Ravana, the lord of demons heard Vibhishana's words and overcome with anger replied:

40013481.author: पदार्थः
40013481.content: शत्रुसूदन O slayer of foes, पापानाम् of sinners, वधे in killing, पापम् sin, न विद्यते not incurred, तस्मात् so, पापचारिणम् this sinner, एनम् him, वानरम् vanara, वधिष्यामि will slay.

40013481.author: Translation
40013481.content: "O slayer of foes it is not wrong to kill a sinner. I shall, therefore, kill the sinful vanara."

40013482.author: पदार्थः
40013482.content: बुद्धिमताम् among the wise, वरिष्ठः foremost, विभीषणः Vibhishana, अधर्ममूलम् unrigteous, बहुरोषयुक्तम् mighty angry, अनार्यजुष्टम् not acceptable to noble souls, वचनम् words, निशम्य after hearing, परमार्थतत्त्वम् supreme truth, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.

40013482.author: Translation
40013482.content: On hearing his brother's harsh words spoken in tremendous anger, which were not acceptable to noble souls, wise Vibhishana again spoke these words of supreme truth:

40013483.author: पदार्थः
40013483.content: लङ्केश्वर lord of Lanka, राक्षसेन्द्र king of demons, प्रसीद calm down, धर्मार्थयुक्तम् which is the essence of  dharma and artha, वचनम् words, शृणुष्व listen, राजन् O king, सर्वेषु for all, समयेषु conditions, सर्वत्र for all places, दूतान् emissaries, अवध्यान् not to be killed, सन्तः elders, वदन्ति have declared.

40013483.author: Translation
40013483.content: "O lord of Lanka O king of demons be pleased to listen to my words which are the essence of dharma and artha. The elders have declared that the emissaries should not be killed by any means.

40013484.author: पदार्थः
40013484.content: अयम् this, शत्रुः enemy, प्रवृद्धः has grown, असंशयम् no doubt, अनेन by him, अप्रमेयम् incomparable, अप्रियम् unpleasant act, कृतं हि indeed has been done, सन्तः wise, दूतवध्याम् killing of an emissary, न प्रवदन्ति do not approve, दूतस्य emissary's, बहवः  many, दण्डाः punishments, दृष्टाः हि indeed have recommended.

40013484.author: Translation
40013484.content: This enemy has done a lot of harm, no doubt. Indeed he has done terrible and unpleasant deeds. (Yet) the wise have recommended many alternate punishments, while prohibiting their killing.

40013485.author: पदार्थः
40013485.content: अङ्गेषु in limbs, वैरूप्यम् deforming, कशाभिघातः flogging, मौण्ड्यम् shaving the head, तथा similarly, लक्षणसन्निपातः disfigurement, एतान् such of those, दूते for an emissary, दण्डान् punishments, प्रवदन्ति elders have prescribed, दूतस्य for emissary, वधस्तु killing of, श्रुतः heard, नास्ति never.

40013485.author: Translation
40013485.content: "Mutilation of limbs, flogging, shaving of the head, and deforming limbs etc. these punishments have been prescribed for an emissary. Never has killing of an emissary been heard.

40013486.author: पदार्थः
40013486.content: धर्मार्थविनीतबुद्धिः wellversed in dharma and artha, परावरप्रत्ययनिश्चितार्थः  who decides about the good and bad, भवद्विधः learned one like you, कोपवशे charged with anger, कथम् how, तिष्ठेत् (are you) swayed, सत्त्ववन्तः courageous ones, कोपम् anger, नियच्छन्ति हि indeed control.

40013486.author: Translation
40013486.content: "You are wellversed  in  dharma and artha. Learned men first decide what is right or wrong (before imposing punishment). How are you swayed by unjust anger? Indeed courageous persons (like you) should control anger.

40013487.author: पदार्थः
40013487.content: वीर O hero, धर्मवादे in the discussion on dharma, तव your, तुल्यः equal, कश्चित् any one, न विद्येत does not exist, लोकवृत्ते in the practice worldly affairs, न not, शास्त्रबुद्धिग्रहणेषु चापि in grasping the subtle truths in sastras, न no, त्वम् you, सर्वसुरासुराणाम् among all suras and asuras, उत्तमः हि indeed superior.

40013487.author: Translation
40013487.content: "Heroic Ravana there is hardly any one who is equal to you in the knowledge of dharma, in the practice of worldly affairs and in grasping subtle truths of sastras. Indeed you are supreme among suras and asuras.

40013488.author: पदार्थः
40013488.content: निशाचरेन्द्रः O kings of demons, शूरेण by the brave, वीरेण by the courageous, सुरासुराणामपि among suras and asuras also, दुर्जयेन the invincible, त्वया you are, प्रगल्भा: efficient, सुरदैत्यसङ्घा hosts of suras and daityas, नरेन्द्राः kings, युद्धेषु in wars, असकृत् repeatedly, जिताश्च won by you.

40013488.author: Translation
40013488.content: "You are the king of demons. Hosts of gods and daityas efficient in wars are conquered by you again and again since you are a brave warrior invincible to gods and demons.

40013489.author: पदार्थः
40013489.content: अस्य at this, कपेः monkey's, घाते in killing, अहम् I, किञ्चित् गुणम् even little use, न पश्यामि not see, अयम् he, दण्डः punishment, यैः by those, अयं कपिः this vanara, प्रेषितः have been sent, तेषु at them, पात्यताम् you may pronounce.

40013489.author: Translation
40013489.content: "I do not see any use in killing this monkey. Pronounce  punishment on those who have sent this vanara.

40013490.author: पदार्थः
40013490.content: साधुर्वा may be soft, असाधुर्यदि वा or hard, एषः he, परैः by others, समर्पितः sent, परार्थम् by others, ब्रुवन् while speaking, परवान् he is dependent, दूतः emissary, वधम् killing, न अर्हति does not deserve.

40013490.author: Translation
40013490.content: "Whether he is soft or harsh, he has been sent by others. He is speaking on other's behalf and is dependent on them. An emissary does not deserve to be killed.

40013491.author: पदार्थः
40013491.content: राजन् O king, अपि च and even so, अस्मिन् when he, हते is killed, यः whoever, महोदधेः ocean, परं पारम् to the other side, पुनः again, इह here, आगच्छेत् who can come, अन्यम् other, खेचरम् who can come through sky and reach, न पश्यामि I do not see.

40013491.author: Translation
40013491.content: "O king If he is killed, I do not see any one who can cross this great ocean and come by air to reach this place.

40013492.author: पदार्थः
40013492.content: परपुरञ्जय O hero who can conquer citadels of enemies, तस्मात् therefore, अस्य him, वधे in killing, यत्नः effort, न कार्यः should not be made, भवान् you, सेन्द्रेषु including Indra, देवेषु among gods, यत्नम् effort, आस्थातुम् to make, अर्हति you are fit.

40013492.author: Translation
40013492.content: "You who can conquer citadels of enemies should not direct your efforts to kill an envoy.You are fit to make efforts against enemies like gods including Indra.

40013493.author: पदार्थः
40013493.content: युद्धप्रिय O lover of war, अस्मिन् if he, विनष्टे is slain, दुर्विनीतौ those two illmannered, दीर्घपथावरुद्धौ those two who are obstructed, तौ नरराजपुत्रौ those princes, यः who ever, युद्धाय for war, उद्योजयेत् can incite, अन्यम्  another, दूतम् emissary, न पश्यामि हि I donot see indeed.

40013493.author: Translation
40013493.content: "O lover of war if Hanuman is slain I do not see any one who can incite those two illmannered sons of the king who are prevented from reaching this faroff land.

40013494.author: पदार्थः
40013494.content: नैतानाम् for rakshasas, मनोनन्दन delighter, पराक्रमोत्साहमनस्विनां च endowed with valour, energy, सुरासुराणामपि even if gods or demons, दुर्जयेन by the invincible one, त्वया you, युद्धायतिः chances of war, नाशयितुम् to lose, न युक्ता not proper.

40013494.author: Translation
40013494.content: "O delighter of demons even the gods and demons who are endowed with valour and energy cannot win you. You are invincible. It is not proper for you to lose chances of a good war.

40013495.author: पदार्थः
40013495.content: ते to you, हिताश्च wellwishers, शूराश्च courageous, समाहिताश्च wellestablished, महागुणेषु with good qualities, कुलेषु in such races, जाताः born, मनस्विनः intellectuals, शस्त्रभृताम् among wielders of weapons, वरिष्ठाः foremost, सुभृताश्च wellpaid warriors, योधाः warriors, कोट्यग्रतः  in your presence.

40013495.author: Translation
40013495.content: "You have with you wellwishers, courageous ones, who have good qualities born in a good race, who are noble, sensible people, wielders of weapons and wellpaid warriors in crores.

40013496.author: पदार्थः
40013496.content: तत् so, तव your, आदेशकृतः those who obey you, केचित् some, बलस्य army's, एकदेशेन with one part, मूढौ two foolish ones, तौ those two, राजपुत्रौ two sons of a king, विनिगृह्य capture, परेषु among your enemies, ते your, प्रभावम् power, भावयितुम् to exhibit, अभियान्तु they may march out for war.

40013496.author: Translation
40013496.content: By your order let some strong soldiers from one contingency go and capture the two sons of the king, to exhibit your power over the enemy.
